```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
# Locate the project root INDEPENDENTLY of the working directory, then load the
# CV helpers. Positron/Quarto may render with the working dir set to the page
# folder, the project root, or the workspace root *above* the project — so we
# can't just walk up from getwd(). Prefer Quarto's QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR, then the
# .qmd's own location, then the working dir.
.find_root <- function() {
  walk_up <- function(start) {
    d <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
    for (i in 1:12) {
      if (file.exists(file.path(d, "_quarto.yml"))) {
        return(d)
      }
      p <- dirname(d)
      if (p == d) {
        break
      }
      d <- p
    }
    NULL
  }
  pd <- Sys.getenv("QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR", "")
  if (nzchar(pd) && file.exists(file.path(pd, "_quarto.yml"))) {
    return(pd)
  }
  ci <- tryCatch(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE), error = function(e) "")
  if (nzchar(ci)) {
    r <- walk_up(dirname(normalizePath(ci, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)))
    if (!is.null(r)) return(r)
  }
  r <- walk_up(getwd())
  if (!is.null(r)) r else getwd()
}
.root <- .find_root()
options(cvsite_root = .root)
source(file.path(.root, "R", "cv-helpers.R"))
```

## Citations

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
# The same counts as the Calepin page: calepin-site/scripts/update-citations.py
# copies data/citations.json here (Academic), and
# calepin-site/scripts/update-policy-reach.py data/policy-reach.json (Policy)
# and calepin-site/scripts/update-media-reach.py data/media-reach.json (Media),
# on every Calepin build. "Updated" is the most recent month; a source whose
# numbers are older names its own month.
cites <- jsonlite::read_json(file.path(.root, "data", "citations.json"))
scopus <- cites$scopus
gs <- cites$google_scholar
oa <- cites$openalex
pr <- jsonlite::read_json(file.path(.root, "data", "policy-reach.json"))
policy <- c(list(as_of = max(unlist(pr$as_of))), pr$totals)
md <- jsonlite::read_json(file.path(.root, "data", "media-reach.json"))
media <- c(list(as_of = md$as_of), md$totals)
latest <- max(scopus$as_of, gs$as_of, oa$as_of, policy$as_of, media$as_of)
# month.name, not format(), so the month stays English in any locale
month <- function(ym) paste(month.name[as.integer(substr(ym, 6, 7))], substr(ym, 1, 4))
when <- function(s) if (s$as_of != latest) paste0(" (", month(s$as_of), ")") else ""
num <- function(n) format(n, big.mark = ",")
cat(
  sprintf("_Updated: %s_\n\n", month(latest)),
  "### Academic\n\n",
  sprintf("- [Scopus](https://www.scopus.com/authid/detail.uri?authorId=23493968300)%s: %s (h-index = %s)\n",
          when(scopus), num(scopus$citations), scopus$h_index),
  sprintf("- [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=8AO7H9gAAAAJ&hl=en)%s: %s (h-index = %s, i10-index = %s)\n",
          when(gs), num(gs$citations), gs$h_index, gs$i10_index),
  sprintf("- [OpenAlex](https://openalex.org/authors/A5015716464)%s: %s (h-index = %s, i10-index = %s; [reach by country and discipline](citation-reach.qmd))\n",
          when(oa), num(oa$citations), oa$h_index, oa$i10_index),
  "\n### Policy\n\n",
  sprintf(paste0("- Think tanks and other policy organisations%s: %s policy documents and %s research works, ",
                 "from %s organisations in %s countries ([Sage Policy Profiles](https://policyprofiles.sagepub.com/profile/21087/ben-stanley) ",
                 "and [OpenAlex](https://openalex.org/authors/A5015716464); [reach by organisation and country](policy-reach.qmd))\n"),
          when(policy), num(policy$documents), num(policy$works), num(policy$organisations), num(policy$countries)),
  "\n### Media\n\n",
  sprintf(paste0("- News media%s: %s articles quoting, interviewing or citing me, in %s outlets in %s countries ",
                 "and %s languages (Google News and Google Alerts; [reach by outlet and country](media-reach.qmd))\n"),
          when(media), num(media$articles), num(media$outlets), num(media$countries), num(media$languages)),
  sep = ""
)
```
